the synthesis of phosphatidic acid derivatives containing a drug or a cytotoxic agent.

The main takeaway from our work is that

it is possible to covalently link two different anticancer drugs to a single phospholipid molecule and that the resulting molecule can be incorporated in a liposome bilayers and used as a drug delivery system.

the phospholipids containing DHA in the 1-position and MTX in 2-position are potent inhibitors of murine leukemia L1210 cell proliferation, more effective than the phospholipides containing stearic acids in the 1 position, and that DHA and MTX appear to synergize with one another when they are added as free agents and covalently linked to the phosphatidyl moiety.
